narratives.name: Modernize Infrastructure Practice Intent
narratives.description: The end-to-end narrative of the infrastructure modernization sales play from customer discovery through deal advancement and expansion.

narrativeContexts.context: Enterprise customers face a convergence of infrastructure challenges -- aging legacy systems consuming maintenance budgets, rising virtualization and cloud costs from proprietary vendors, security and compliance drift across fragmented environments, and vendor lock-in limiting workload flexibility. The Modernize Infrastructure play equips sellers with a structured Customer Lens to diagnose these pain points and map them to desired outcomes around cost reduction, risk mitigation, and operational flexibility.

The play validates Red Hat's infrastructure modernization positioning through a three-TDP technology stack -- Server/Cloud OS for OS standardization and cloud migration, Virtualization for VM migration and consolidation, and Container Management for modern workload deployment. This layered approach creates a phased modernization journey that addresses immediate migration needs while establishing a path to cloud-native operations.

Value articulation centers on three infrastructure-specific value drivers -- Cost (reduced VM and cloud spend through consolidation and open-source economics), Complexity (consistent user and operational experience across all footprints), and Choice (workload portability across on-premise, cloud, and edge without vendor lock-in). Customer references like Emirates NBD (9,000+ VMs migrated) and CAE (standardized hybrid multicloud) substantiate each driver.

Infrastructure modernization deals progress through migration assessment workshops, proof-of-concept deployments, and phased migration plans that reduce risk and demonstrate value incrementally. The three-TDP alignment enables sellers to present a comprehensive infrastructure transformation while allowing customers to adopt components at their own pace.

Deal advancement integrates infrastructure assessment services, migration tooling, and partner ecosystem solutions into a commercially structured modernization program. Pipeline attribution to the Modernize Infrastructure play enables measurement of infrastructure-focused go-to-market effectiveness.

Successful infrastructure modernization creates expansion pathways -- OS standardization leads to virtualization migration, which leads to container adoption, creating a natural multi-TDP expansion motion. Performance measurement across the three infrastructure TDPs identifies which modernization pathways generate the highest expansion rates.

narratives.name: Modernize Infrastructure Play Context and Rationale
narratives.description: Why the Modernize Infrastructure play matters within the three-level go-to-market framework.

narrativeContexts.context: Enterprise infrastructure organizations face a converging set of pressures -- legacy systems consuming 60-80% of IT budgets, rising virtualization costs from proprietary vendors implementing aggressive licensing changes, security compliance drift across fragmented hybrid environments, and vendor lock-in preventing workload flexibility across deployment targets.

The Modernize Infrastructure play must equip sellers to diagnose infrastructure pain points, engage CIO/VP Infrastructure/CTO personas with tailored discovery, align three infrastructure TDPs (Server/Cloud OS, Virtualization, Container Management) to the customer's modernization landscape, and articulate value through infrastructure-specific cost, complexity, and choice drivers.

Sellers apply the infrastructure Customer Lens to assess VM inventory, cloud footprint, and legacy proportion. They engage infrastructure decision-makers with persona-specific discovery questions, construct multi-TDP solution narratives connecting OS standardization through VM migration to container adoption, and present phased modernization journeys substantiated by customer references like Emirates NBD and CAE.

Structured infrastructure play execution creates multi-TDP deal opportunities where OS standardization leads to virtualization migration and container adoption, generating expansion revenue and deepening technology adoption across the customer's infrastructure stack.

narratives.name: How to Apply Infrastructure Customer Lens
narratives.description: Technique guidance for applying the infrastructure Customer Lens to diagnose customer pain.

narrativeContexts.context: The seller begins an infrastructure modernization engagement by applying the play's structured Customer Lens, which organizes the customer's infrastructure world into four categories -- pain points, desired outcomes, business impact, and real-world examples from comparable infrastructure transformations.

The seller maps customer-stated and observed infrastructure challenges to the play's pain taxonomy, connects priorities to outcome categories, and quantifies business impact using the play's infrastructure-specific framework. Customer references are matched by industry, scale, and modernization type.

Apply the Customer Lens during initial account research and discovery conversations. Assess the customer's infrastructure portfolio including VM count, cloud footprint, and legacy proportion. Document which infrastructure pain points resonate most strongly and where gaps exist for further discovery.
A documented infrastructure Customer Lens analysis that feeds persona engagement and TDP alignment activities, with quantified business impact and matched customer references ready for sharing.

narratives.name: How to Engage Infrastructure Decision-Makers
narratives.description: Technique guidance for persona-tailored infrastructure discovery.

narrativeContexts.context: The Modernize Infrastructure play defines three key infrastructure personas, each with distinct priorities -- CIO/Head of IT Strategy focused on legacy cost reduction and innovation funding, VP Infrastructure/IT Operations focused on VM and cloud cost optimization, and CTO/Head of Platform Engineering focused on scalable architecture and cloud spend control.

Prepare persona-specific call plans using infrastructure discovery questions. Research individuals using available tools. Lead with discovery questions from the play rather than product pitches, listening for language that maps to infrastructure current reality descriptions.

Engage each persona with tailored infrastructure messaging. Validate budget consumption by legacy maintenance, skills gaps in modern infrastructure, and rising operational complexity. Sequence conversations starting with the technical influencer, validating with the infrastructure sponsor, and engaging the economic buyer with quantified infrastructure cost arguments.
Multi-stakeholder engagement pattern established with documented persona responses, validated infrastructure pain points, and an identified champion among infrastructure decision-makers.

narratives.name: How to Align Infrastructure TDPs
narratives.description: Technique guidance for mapping customer technology decisions to infrastructure TDPs.

narrativeContexts.context: The Modernize Infrastructure play is powered by three TDPs that form a layered infrastructure modernization stack. Server/Cloud OS provides OS standardization and cloud migration. Virtualization provides VM migration and consolidation. Container Management provides modern workload deployment.

Assess the customer's infrastructure technology decision landscape against the play's three-TDP alignment. Determine which TDPs are relevant based on the customer's active decisions, timelines, and evaluation scope.

Navigate the TDP-to-tactic alignment for each relevant infrastructure area. For a customer struggling with VM sprawl, align Virtualization tactics. For OS fragmentation, align Server/Cloud OS tactics. Construct the multi-TDP narrative as a phased modernization journey -- OS standardization leads to VM migration leads to container adoption.
An infrastructure TDP alignment map with prioritized technology areas, matched tactics, and a multi-TDP solution narrative presenting a phased modernization journey for the customer.

narrativeContexts.context: Infrastructure modernization engagements frequently span multiple technology domains -- a customer migrating from proprietary virtualization needs OS standardization, VM migration tooling, and a path to containerized workloads for future applications.

Construct a layered infrastructure solution narrative connecting Server/Cloud OS (OS standardization and cloud migration), Virtualization (VM migration and consolidation), and Container Management (modern workload deployment) into a phased modernization journey.

A phased modernization narrative is constructed connecting OS standardization through VM migration to container adoption, creating a coherent infrastructure transformation story.

patternViews.name: Value and Validation
patternViews.description: Articulate infrastructure value through cost, complexity, and choice drivers.

narrativeContexts.context: The seller presents Red Hat's infrastructure value through three domain-specific drivers -- cost reduction through VM consolidation and open-source economics, complexity reduction through consistent hybrid management, and choice preservation through workload portability. Customer references (Emirates NBD, CAE, Suncorp) substantiate each value claim with infrastructure-specific evidence.

patternViews.name: Deal Advancement
patternViews.description: Convert validated infrastructure value into deal commitment.

narrativeContexts.context: The seller converts validated infrastructure value into concrete next steps -- migration assessment workshops, infrastructure POCs, or phased migration plans. Deals are registered with pipeline attributed to the Modernize Infrastructure play, and performance measurement tracks infrastructure-specific conversion and expansion rates.

Successful infrastructure modernization creates natural expansion -- OS standardization leads to virtualization migration leads to container adoption, generating multi-TDP expansion revenue and deepening technology adoption across the customer's infrastructure stack.
